additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
We are experiencing "Missing Converters" errors on different devices, where only a few converters remain active.
As you can see in the attached picture, the converters are not working.
So far, we have observed this issue on 4 different devices. Their IDs are listed below:
- ZfA6ox
- 1MWgs6
- vK6bNu
- SGYTwW
Additionally, this error sometimes resolves itself, sometimes it is fixed after a reboot, but after a while it occurs again.
We have performed on-site service checks but could not find any clear root cause.
This is an urgent and critical issue, and we kindly request your detailed support and investigation.

additional_info.subject: ID0448200-DC/Si-D/TR-[multi] Missing Converters problems CRM:02889000585
additional_info.body:
Hello Yigit-abi,
Today we went on-site and performed the tests to prove there is something wrong the logic after PowerSave mode is activated.
When we reach the site, the converters had error but we needed to install v8.0.5 in order to collect all the logs to make sure R&D can take a look.
When the update was installed successfully we see all 15 converters grouped and ready:
Then we go from RUNNING to POWER_SAVE and when we try a session a random number of converters get deactivated:
We can charge with limited power.
When we reboot the charger again, and do the same steps, we get a different amount of converters:
After removing the Power_Save mode and reboot the charger, it's able to charge at full power without any problems.
For now, as we agreed, this customer agreed to have the Power Save mode disabled and test if v6.1.3 is working properly. We can do the downgrade on Monday, since it's Friday, we don't want to ruin the weekend :D
Please ask the other customers as well for the rest of the chargers: ZfA6ox, 1MWgs6, SGYTwW
The idea is to remove the power save mode for now while we troubleshoot this charger from today which is the closest to you.
Before I create the ticket to R&D I would like to test the v6.1.3 because this way it will be a lot faster for them to give us a solution since it will be FW problem.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
